$description: Manifest for all screenshots and screencasts used in the HAL Foundation documentation. Every media file must be listed here, regardless of whether it is captured automatically or manually. The capture script (capture.mjs) uses entries with capture recipes (path, waitFor, actions) to automate screenshot taking. Entries with 'automated: false' must be captured manually at the configured dimensions. The validation script (validate.mjs) checks dimensions, manifest completeness, and staleness.

dashboard.png.description: Dashboard overview with all cards in light theme, showing server info, status, host, JVM, memory, log, health, and deployments

dashboard-dark.png.description: Dashboard overview in dark theme, demonstrating theme adaptation across all cards

universal-search-mgt.png.description: Universal search in model graph mode, showing grouped results for resources, attributes, operations, and capabilities matching a keyword

universal-search-address.png.description: Universal search in address navigation mode, showing typeahead completion resolving wildcards against the live server
